story_summary: A young poet wanders a deserted city avenue at midnight, lost in thought under the amber glow of streetlamps. His solitary walk is a quiet plea for his story to be remembered, a search for legacy in the fleeting moments before the night ends. He seeks assurance that his life, like a song, will be sung long after he's gone.

characters.name: The Poet
characters.visual_design: A young man with an expressive, thoughtful face, wearing an oversized dark hoodie, baggy jeans, and worn sneakers. His features are often cast in shadow and highlighted by warm rim lighting.

story_beats.title: Midnight Avenue
story_beats.description: The Poet begins a solitary walk down a quiet, empty city street. The only light comes from the warm, glowing streetlamps, casting long shadows ahead of him.

story_beats.title: Passing Echoes
story_beats.description: He walks past a classic, beautifully maintained parked car, a relic of another time. He glances at his reflection in the window, contemplating the stories and lives that have passed through this same street.

story_beats.title: The Plea
story_beats.description: The Poet stops directly under a streetlamp, looking up into the light as if making a silent promise or a prayer. This is the emotional peak, his face a mix of hope and vulnerability, asking the universe to remember him.

story_beats.title: Fading into Legend
story_beats.description: With a renewed, quiet determination, The Poet continues his walk, moving away from the viewer down the long avenue. His figure slowly becomes a silhouette against the distant city glow, his story now part of the night.

panels.caption: When the lights shut off and it's my turn to settle down...
My main concern: promise that you will sing about me...
Walking down this midnight avenue, streetlamps glowing...
Promise that you will sing about me...
